integrity: Exact symbolic proof with four strictly positive rational gap certificates, an independent construction of grounded matrix costs on finite instances, and a reproducible Python/SymPy checker. No independent mathematical audit or global novelty guarantee.
limitations: Only unweighted complete tripartite K_{1,m,m+1} with integer m>=2, exactly two perfectly pinned leaders, unnormalized grounded Laplacian, and inverse-square trace. No claims for general powers, gains or graph families.
title: A three-part inverse-square leader switch on \(K_{1,m,m+1}\)
